reasons.plan: Adeline wants a go-wide attack plan, and Divine Visitation, Waylay, Worthy Knight and Inquisitorial Rosette serve it, but well over a fifth of the deck (Tsabo's Web, Dawn-Blessed Pennant, Righteous Avengers, Silkenfist Order, Tine Shrike, Darksteel Brute, Luck Bobblehead) doesn't.
reasons.fit: The refine made a single swap, cutting Curse of Conformity for Molten-Tail Masticore, a clunky repeatable damage source with an upkeep discard cost, so it added barely any removal and left obvious weak cards such as Tsabo's Web, Righteous Avengers and Dawn-Blessed Pennant in place.
reasons.mana: Mono-white colours are dependable, but 45 lands (43 Plains, Cactus Preserve and a Makindi land) is far too many for a curve that peaks at 3 mana.
reasons.ramp: Only Commander's Sphere, Darksteel Ingot and Luck Bobblehead are real ramp, with one-shot help from Golden Egg, Magic Pot and Foundry Inspector, which is thin for a curve with eight cards at 6 or more mana.
reasons.draw: Many small cantrips (Golden Egg, Tsabo's Web, Scroll of Avacyn, Implement of Improvement, Novice Inspector, Wrench, Combat Thresher, Commander's Sphere) plus Ginger's monarch and Harper Recruiter give a trickle of cards but little strong repeatable draw.
reasons.interaction: Removal is limited to Arbalest Elite, Tower of Calamities, Molten-Tail Masticore and the awkward Worldslayer wipe, alongside tappers and light protection from Cliffside Rescuer and Haystack, with no real answers to noncreature threats.

details.summary: A loosely built Adeline tokens deck with too many lands, little ramp and scant interaction, and the requested refine changed only one card rather than meaningfully adding removal or cutting the many weak cards.

reasons.plan: Adeline's go-wide attacking plan is backed by Divine Visitation, Inquisitorial Rosette, Worthy Knight and Springjack Shepherd, but well over a fifth of the deck doesn't serve it, such as Bargain, Tsabo's Web, Dawn-Blessed Pennant, Curse of Conformity, Tower of Calamities and Gate to the Afterlife.
reasons.fit: Only 2 Plains were cut, leaving 39 lands instead of the requested 37, and the additions are a vanilla Alpha Myr and Loran of the Third Path, neither of which meaningfully supports Adeline's go-wide attacks.
reasons.mana: Mono-white colours are dependable with 37 Plains, but 39 lands (counting Cactus Preserve and Makindi Mesas, both of which enter tapped) is too many for a curve that peaks at 3.
reasons.ramp: Only Commander's Sphere, Darksteel Ingot, Luck Bobblehead, plus the one-shot Golden Egg and Magic Pot's Treasure, which is thin ramp for a deck with 15 cards at 5 mana or more.

reasons.interaction: Answers are narrow and clunky: Loran, Arbalest Elite, Tower of Calamities and Molten-Tail Masticore, with only Worldslayer as an awkward board reset and Haystack and Cliffside Rescuer for protection.

reasons.plan: Most cards serve a Kangee flyers-aggro plan (Empyrean Eagle, Steel-Plume Marshal, Thunderclap Wyvern, Favorable Winds, Gravitational Shift), but Phyrexian Censor, Felidar Retreat, Whiskervale Forerunner, Vow of Duty and White Sun's Zenith are off-plan or anti-synergistic.
reasons.fit: It raises lands from 26 to 36 and adds Sol Ring and Arcane Signet as asked, though some cuts (Cut Short, Prayer of Binding, Winged Words, Skyscanner) were useful interaction or draw rather than clearly the weakest cards.
reasons.mana: Thirty-six lands suit a curve topping out around 5, and the two colours are well supported, but about seven lands enter tapped (Coastal Tower, Meandering River, Sejiri Refuge, Temple, Tranquil Cove, Uncharted Haven, sometimes Prairie Stream).
reasons.ramp: About nine pieces (Sol Ring, Arcane Signet, Azorius Signet, Talisman of Progress, Commander's Sphere, Sky Diamond, Hedron Archive, Wayfarer's Bauble, Cartographer's Hawk, plus Warden of Evos Isle), though several are slow.
reasons.draw: More than ten sources, including repeatable engines like Windreader Sphinx, Tide Skimmer, Bident of Thassa, Dawn of Hope and Staggering Insight, plus Sphinx's Revelation and Distant Melody.
reasons.interaction: Plenty of flexible answers: four counterspells plus Assimilate Essence, Condemn, Fading Hope, Hanged Executioner, Disenchant, Crush Contraband, Aetherize, and wipes in Cleansing Nova and Time Wipe, backed by protection spells.

details.summary: A solid Azorius flyers deck that the refine makes castable, with strong draw and interaction and only a handful of off-theme cards. The change does what was asked, though a few cut cards were stronger than some that stayed.

reasons.plan: Most of the deck is Zombie lords, amass, recursion and mass-reanimation such as Zombie Apocalypse and Army of the Damned, but around a fifth of it serves no Zombie plan: Faerie Mastermind, Faerie Formation, Lightshell Duo, Skyscanner, Terror of Towashi, Winged Words and Liliana's Talent.

reasons.plan: Most cards serve a Kangee flyers plan (Empyrean Eagle, Thunderclap Wyvern, Steel-Plume Marshal, Gravitational Shift, Rally of Wings, Sephara), but a handful drift off-plan, such as Whiskervale Forerunner, Lightshell Duo, Felidar Retreat, Vow of Duty and White Sun's Zenith.
